notes.title: Major Optimization and Lighting Update
notes.content:
In this update, our players gained initial access to our Virtual Geometry and Virtual Texture software technologies. Thanks to these innovative optimization techniques, significant performance improvements were achieved, resulting in a much more stable gaming experience. Furthermore, these software technologies will continue to be developed in future updates, enabling the addition of more realistic lighting alongside even higher performance.


Essentially, the Virtual Geometry (commonly known as Nanite) and Realtime GI (commonly known as Lumen) technologies were written from scratch specifically for the Unity game engine and integrated into Quinfall. With this update, 60% of the game has been migrated to these systems. We will soon reach 100%.


Performance & Graphics 

Major optimization work completed. Systems with CPU bottlenecks now experience a 40–90% FPS increase. Additional 30–50% FPS gains are expected soon after GPU optimizations.

Global lighting adjustments made (work ongoing).

Fixed several visual errors detected in the beta channel.

Beta client shader corrections applied.

Adjustments made to vegetation.

Fixed minimap UI display issue in the beta channel.

Fixed set bonuses not applying on bags and weapons.

Fixed talisman bonuses incorrectly applying to non-equipment items.

Corrected outdated “G-level” indicators in arena invites, board tasks, etc.

Fixed UI errors in multiple places.

Fixed minimap rendering bug in the beta channel.

Fixed issue with rotten crops not being collectible.


 Gameplay & Balance 

Alchemy station: HP/MP potion crafting level requirements reduced; effects doubled.

Adjustments to alchemy and cooking material requirements.

Several alchemy potion effects and durations modified.

Adjustments to engineering recipes.

Adjustments to smelting station recipes.

Prismite drop rate increased by 75%.

Gathering, farming, and livestock product drop rates adjusted to match new material needs.

Clans: Creation fee updated to 12m silver.

Construction: Durability of built structures increased 10x.

Blue shrines: Defensive tools can now attack here as well.

Ready-made potion drops removed from creatures.

Party members now receive full EXP and shared rewards without division.

Clan war respawn timer reduced from 20s → 10s.

Bees’ maintenance time increased from 8/16h → 12/24h.

Workbenches cannot be removed if talismans or power stones are inside.

Beehives cannot be removed if they contain harvested products.

CH4: Players outside party/clan/alliance can no longer revive others.

Kraken Boss: Character attacks no longer deal damage—only cannonballs can.

Ships: Crafting stations disabled onboard.

Fishing bait can now be used directly for fishing.

Dungeon chests are now party-member exclusive.

New costumes added to the game.


 System & Technical 

Beta channel closed. Players should now log in through the main channel.,

Export command added: typing /resource_export in chat saves required data (JSON & PNG) into C:\\Q_item_kaynak_db. Data includes item sources for community Wiki/guide preparation. Clan war times, boss schedules, and other live server data will soon be available via Firebase DB for API support.


 Localization 

Updates and fixes applied to German, Ukrainian, and Korean localizations.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Major Profession Update
notes.content:
The world of Quinfall is expanding with brand-new processing and crafting professions! Players can now enjoy a deeper and more rewarding profession experience. With the newly introduced Beekeeping profession, you can harvest nature’s sweetest resources and manage your own hives — becoming part of an all-new production chain that ranges from honey harvesting to beeswax crafting.


In addition, several new professions have been added in the fields of processing and production. You can refine raw materials obtained from mines into more valuable resources or craft unique items from rare components. These professions will offer significant advantages not only in trade but also during clan wars and special events.


Furthermore, all existing professions in the game have been thoroughly reworked. Crafting recipes and progression systems have been redesigned to meet modern player expectations. Every profession now offers a sense of meaningful progress, satisfying rewards, and a deeper role within the game world.



[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43570153/b6aa5079691466f3fe3131ca6806c7620fa3a21d.png"]
[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43570153/bd3795ed5e174adc2f706474397ef8be3a532bc8.png"]
[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//43570153/20138f213b2d562858eadc84a081a96f68315c6b.png"]

Don't miss the chance to experience the new profession system — there’s so much to master in Quinfall!

Güncelleme Notları:

New Content

32 brand-new workbenches have been added to the game.

10 new professions have been introduced.

Batch equipment crafting has been implemented.

New farm animals for Animal Husbandry and new seeds for the Harvesting profession have been added.
[hr][/hr]
Systems & Mechanics Adjustments

Various updates applied to existing workbenches.

Profession level cap set to 100; all “G‐Level” indicators removed.

Character levels no longer display “G‐Level” prefixes (e.g. “G50” now appears simply as Level 100).

Thief NPC ambushes removed from overland caravan transports.

Decoration recipes have been moved to the Carpenter’s workbench.

Siege‐engine recipes have been moved to the Engineering workbench.

Mining and stone‐crushing physics have been improved.

Major changes made to every collectible resource; all previously gathered resources have been auto‐converted to the new system.

External biome resources removed from mining and plant‐gathering zones.

Significant under‐the‐hood improvements to the build system.

Tamed animals now stop producing food when their hunger reaches zero instead of dying.

Destroying a player‐built structure now refunds 50% of the materials spent.

The Aero‐Forge region has been reworked.

In the Referral System, new players will see the “enter referral code” prompt on every login until they create their first character.
[hr][/hr]
Balance & Economy Changes

Ancient Armor Piece drop rate permanently increased by 150%.

All equipment drops from bosses and dungeon rewards have been removed; special materials for adding Power and Set Bonuses at crafting benches have been added both to crafting recipes and to legacy boss/dungeon loot tables.

Farmer harvest time increased from 8 hours to 12 hours.

Lifeskill EXP boost effects have been reduced by 30% to correct over‐buffing when combined with other bonuses.

The probability of obtaining higher‐grade items from equipment crafting has been increased.

Equipment Chests as Arena rewards have been removed; Material Chests count has been increased, and now include Power Stones and Set‐Bonus Talismans. Existing Equipment Chests have been converted into Material Chests.

Degraded skill stones can no longer be sold on the Central Market.

Additional security measures implemented to prevent transfer of non‐tradable items by any means.
[hr][/hr]
Clan War & Event Adjustments

Fixed a bug where Clan War EXP was sometimes awarded at ×3.

Clan Wars are temporarily limited to 12 participants; the first 12 members on your roster will be able to join.

Spectator mode in Clan Wars is disabled until the upcoming combat system revision.

Clan War reward payouts for 2nd place and below have been slightly reduced.

Clan War base gates have been widened.
[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes & Improvements

Fixed an issue where workbenches inside rental houses would reset when entering or exiting the property.

Corrected a bug that prevented certain mount skills from activating.

Prevented last‐second entries into Arena battles.

Players who exit an event can no longer join another event for 10 minutes (currently applies to Arena and Zenith events).

Fixed cases where seeds deposited in storage appeared as corrupted “X” icons.

Altar support‐system error detection has been temporarily disabled.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Battle for Zenith
notes.content:
New Feature: Party Finder


“Every hero deserves a team.”

You asked we delivered.



The long-awaited automated dungeon party system is finally here! Based on overwhelming community feedback, we’ve developed a tool that lets players instantly match with others who fit their role and build preferences.



No more manual invites, no more spamming chat channels just queue up and dive into adventure. This has been one of the most requested quality-of-life features, and we’re proud to bring it to life.



Time to find your perfect party and conquer together!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/2fcdefd78df8722b5f08d639d0fea9228e1f7e82.png"]
New Event: Zenith Conquest

The battlefield awaits your glory.


Zenith Conquest is a dynamic event alternating between PvE and PvP daily no two days are the same. Here’s how it works:



📌 System Highlights:

Mode switches daily, determined by the system.

Up to 25 players per flag, 100 players per battlefield, and additional rooms open based on demand.

Teams are assigned randomly upon registration.

PvP Mode: Teams clash!

PvE Mode: Common enemy mutual hostility disabled.

Objective: Team up, whittle down the Boss’s health, and climb the damage-ranking ladder.

Battle ends when the Boss is defeated or time runs out.



🎁 Rewards:

Based on total damage dealt by each team.

Ranking ladder grants increasingly valuable loot.


Bug Fixes & Improvements


Fixed an issue where the Pelthera buff duration was not visually updating in real time.

Fixed a bug that allowed multiple build objects to be placed at the same location due to momentary lag.

Major backend work was done to address a memory leak that could occur when players traveled long distances on the map without restarting the game. Improvements will continue based on player feedback.

Fixed an issue where lost raft treasures at sea were not counted toward clan missions.

Adjusted Clan War rewards: Bronze League rewards have been removed, and Clan EXP has been added to the reward pool.

Players who participate in any session of a Clan War are now restricted from joining war rounds for a new clan for 5 days.

Increased the amount of Silver required to create a clan.

Fixed an issue that prevented character movement at the front of warships.

Significantly reduced the sound radius of guitar-playing NPCs in cities.

Added an option to remotely delete altars from the altar control window in certain situations.

Fixed a rare issue where build objects placed in altar areas would collapse over time due to a support system bug.

Houses for Rent and Farms for Rent are now permanently switched to the purchase system. Some adjustments have been made to their prices. In addition, already rented houses and fields have been updated as purchased.

Prevented placement of new altars on top of trees.

Fixed a rare bug where some players could not see ships due to harbor NPC errors.

Improved Russian language localization.

notes.title: The Quinfall – Awakening of Pelthera
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/521dd94577191d9f01fd73e9f12b410085a493f6.png

Pelthera – The Faded Eye of Pelyonas

Pelthera is now present in all major cities across Quinfall, serving the players. This mysterious statue offers unique and powerful buffs in exchange for silver. Each offering resonates through Pelthera’s stone body, awakening an ancient vow and granting extraordinary advantages in battle, loot, and experience. But it must be remembered: Pelthera is a being that never forgets what it gives.

Pelthera does not speak, but it knows the ring of silver.
Each offering hums through its stone veins, awakening an ancient vow.

Those who stand beneath its gaze begin to see the unseen.
Rotting corpses yield what they never held.
Forgotten beasts drop what should never be found.
Weapons grow heavier in hand, hungrier in silence.
And experience bends levels no longer climb, they leap.

But nothing is ever free.
What you take, Pelthera remembers.
Some say their dreams whisper of giving it back.
Too late.

Twitch Drops – June Rewards Have Begun

Throughout June, watch The Quinfall streams and claim exclusive Twitch Drop rewards. The following items are available during the campaign:


 Anostia's Blessing (5 days)
 Ordenus Secret Arts (5 days)
 Valuable Package (5 days)
 Enchanted Phoenix (Pet Costume)

Watch the streams, log in with your linked account, and claim your rewards in-game. Don’t miss this opportunity to enhance your adventure!

Fixes and Improvements

 Visual glass bug on the Trident ship costume has been fixed.
 Sail opening issues on some costume ships have been resolved.
 Speed inconsistency between pirate and merchant ship types when using costumes has been fixed. The costume now adopts the speed of the ship it's equipped on.

UI

 Some UI elements added in the last update no longer shift with different HUD scales.
 Channel information has been added to the watch button for clan wars.

Action Coin & Item Issues

 The issue where Action Coin purchases sometimes cost more than shown has been resolved.
 The “Comfortable Chair” item can now be placed properly for affected players.

Clan Wars

 Clan war interval has been reduced from once per hour to once every 30 minutes.
 Additional measures were implemented to prevent spectator entry into the battlefield. Spectator mode is reactivated.
 Issues with pull and knockdown abilities not working during clan wars have been fixed.
 Special frames have been added to clan banners for those who receive rewards in the final phase of clan wars.

Clan Quests

 The issue where each delivery in sea trade quests counted as 1 regardless of package count has been fixed.
 The required amount for land and monster hunting quests has been reduced.
 Dungeon treasure collection is now properly counted in clan quests.
 Resource gathering counts in hunting-related clan quests now register correctly.

Clan Management

 Fixed a freeze issue when trying to create a new clan with insufficient silver.
 The cost to create a new clan has been updated to 1,000,000 silver.
 Fixed a bug that occurred when selected players for clan war left the clan.

If you're ready, it's time to uncover new secrets beneath the shadow of Pelthera. The waters are darker, the rewards more dangerous. Stay alert Quinfall awaits you!

notes.title: The Quinfall – Clan Wars Begin!
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

The world of Quinfall continues to evolve with our latest content-packed update! Prepare yourselves for powerful new features that will shape your journey and unite your clan like never before. Here’s what awaits you:

New Weapons, Armors & Ships Costume

Make your mark in style! A new collection of visually striking costume weapons and armors has been added, along with majestic costume ships to sail the seas in flair. Whether you're a land warrior or a sea adventurer, it's time to stand out from the crowd.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/c5e62c346040920d8da34225f0a170af54a2e14c.png
Clan Quest System Introduced

Complete weekly and daily challenges together with your clanmates and level up your clan! New Clan Quest system offers fun and rewarding missions that strengthen your bonds and contribute to your clan's progression. Cooperation is key unite, conquer and grow stronger together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/1af09e1f44cd1624d5491d083ecf1ca077fd20d1.png
Clan Passive & Active Skills Added

It's time to turn your clan into a true force to be reckoned with! Unlock and upgrade both passive and active clan skills to boost your group's power in combat, exploration and beyond. Strategize with your leaders invest in your talents, and unleash new abilities that can turn the tide of battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/65ebe94aee563f7d3a521e24df36c8a8e38fe0db.png
Clan War System Enabled

Enter a new era of structured clan battles! The Clan War System now features a fully automated matchmaking interface, where selected clan members face off in scheduled battle rounds across different days. Rise through the leagues  from Bronze to Mastery by securing victories, earning points, and proving your clan’s strength. Each battle is timed, ranked, and rewards are distributed at the end of the war period. 

Weapon Level Transfer Item Now Available

Ever trained your Two-Handed Sword to level 60, only to wish you could wield a Staff instead? Now you can! A brand-new shop item allows you to transfer your weapon level progress from one weapon type to another. Switch styles without losing your grind keep your power, change your path.

Quality of Life & System Improvements

 Q Key Auto-Run Added: Auto-run is now bindable to the Q key. Players who previously set a custom bind may need to update their settings.
 Ship Part Limit Activated: Maximum build and item piece limits are now in effect for ships.
 Name Display Range Increased: Sea creatures and enemy ships now have their name display range tripled.
 Community Supporter Tag Added
 Gender Change Feature: Now included in the Appearance Change Card and time-limited support packs.
 Italian Language Support: Community Support added for Italian players.


Fixes & Adjustments

 Gatherables Visual Bug Fixed: An issue where some gatherable items wouldn’t disappear has been resolved.
 Decay System Improvements: Enhancements made to altar and ship object decay; added safety checks to prevent lost items/structures.
 World Boss Reward UI Fix: Action Coin visual error on reward screen fixed.
 Block List Bug Fix: Issue causing Block List to not display for some players resolved.
 Raw Feed Duration Bug: Corrected duration now reflects 20 minutes instead of incorrectly showing 30.
 Doomcaller Undermesh Prevention: Additional safeguards implemented.
 Sword Pull Skill Safety: Teleportation with sword pull now has ray-checking to prevent players from getting stuck in objects.
 Steam Achievement Icons Updated
 Combat Disabled for Parties in Arena Outskirts
 Debuff Fixes in Arena Outskirts: Resolved issue where certain negative effects weren’t applying to enemies.
 Auto-Warning Messages: New automated in-game alerts added.
 Drop Rate Increased: Sea creatures and lost rafts now have higher drop rates. Enhancement materials also added.


What's Coming NEXT?

 Chanceborn Buff Statue
 Party Finder Feature
 May Roadmap (PvP) Event

notes.title: The Quinfall - Path to Glory
notes.content:
🃏 Twitch Drops Are Coming!

Yep, you heard it right! The Twitch Drop system is now in place.
It’s not active yet, but a big announcement is coming in the next patch!
So get your Twitch channels ready and start tuning in the watch and earn era is near.
Looting has never been this fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/dace5052a52fb9c8c467192ffb44a2388bbe5200.jpg

🥊 Fights in the City — But Make It Safe!

Safe PvP zones are now live in Meadow, Kineallen, Larcbost, and Horus!
Wanna go 1v1 with your friend or just show off your strength? Go for it.
No death penalties. No item loss.
Fighting is free, but leave the drama at the door.
Time to turn the city into your own arena!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/76571eae9f9934bad4eb025d0f6ad5bb7f97133a.jpg

🛡️ Ancient Armor Just Got Way More Player-Friendly

A thousand fragments? Yeah, we thought that was a bit much too...
You spoke, we listened.
The required number of Ancient Armor Fragments has been reduced from 1000 to 100.
And now? They drop not just from special areas, but also Open Dungeon mobs and World Bosses.
Collect them all and unlock a unique costume + title.
Style and power now that's a combo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/4f2d658b14535517cc2342791d1681db716fa24b.png

🏆 Arena Reborn — Now You've Got a Reason to Fight!

Arena wasn’t getting the love it deserved, so we rebuilt it from the ground up.
We talked to the community, took your feedback seriously, and made big changes.

Now:

 Earn Arena Tokens from every fight.
 Spend them in a special reward panel full of useful and flashy items.
 Your kills and points are tracked in your character window and the global rankings.
 Climb the leaderboard to unlock titles and achievement badges.

Oh, and yes stats have been reset with this patch, so everyone gets a fair start.
Time to enter the Arena, prove your worth, and make your name echo through the rankings!

🔧 General Improvements & Fixes

 Server performance has been optimized.
 Sea creatures now properly despawn or move out of bounds after a set time.
 Drop rates for Power Cards and Mount Equipment have been reduced.
 Fixed a visual bug causing duplicated names on the World Map.
 Fixed audio settings not applying correctly to certain buildable objects.
 Improved weapon drop distribution in Dungeons, especially for Sword & Shield.
 Fixed multiple level design issues across various areas.
 Anti-Cheat system has been updated to the latest version.
 Gathering resource depletion notifications have been adjusted; further fixes are in testing.
 Fixed an issue where some skills became unusable after knocking a player down until relogging.
 Added special tags for Ancient Armor Sets and a new Content Creator Tag.
 Fixed an issue where the Central Market couldn't be placed in some Calmarrock locations.
 Fixed the quantity input not working in crafting stations.
 Fixed skill targeting bugs when selected areas were out of range.
 Continued investigation into Global Chat messages not appearing for all intended players.
 Updated the color palette for vegetation and overall world atmosphere.
 Fixed incorrect display of 5-star items in the Central Market.
 Fixed inventory activation issues with some tools.
 Improved synchronization of sea creatures across all players.
 Significantly increased World Boss damage and doubled the chance to drop valuable equipment.
 Fixed a visual issue in Closed Dungeon reward panels.
 Livestock hunger timer has been doubled animals now reach full hunger in 72 hours instead of 36. More changes are planned for this system.

🔮 What’s Coming Next?

Curious about what’s next?
As we promised in the roadmap here’s what’s cooking:

We’re kicking off development on a strategic Clan War system, integrated with the upcoming League System.
Plus, Clan Skills and Passives are officially in the works!

Get ready it won’t just be players making headlines soon… your whole clan will rise.

notes.title: The Quinfall - The Cursed Realms Update
notes.content:
Three cursed realms have awakened! Only the strongests will claim what lies within. New zones have emerged, each one holding deadly secrets, powerful rewards and high level progression materials. Gear up! Danger deeply lurks in every corner.

Drakkmorn Hollow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/1cb2828f867c13c3d001de94c178650563d51041.png

The ruined heart of Dwarven pride now burns with cursed flame. Fight through molten halls, gather high-value ores, and survive the wrath of ancient fire spirits. Every vein of lava hides the resources you need but cannot gain any of them without a fight.

Abyssora Sanctum

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/a7a000d4da9bf5385744b030ea04655fcfddf0fd.png

Deep beneath the sea, a forgotten temple stirs. Inside, rare gathering nodes and a powerful boss await. Find the hidden chamber, take whatever you can, and beware the magic that still flickers in the deep.

Gravemourn Keep

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/ebb292a583d22981c2bb7eb5096ad91c56756a76.png

Perched on a frozen cliff and haunted by the damned, Gravemourn Keep is where sanity frays and the dead whispers your name. Battle through spectral remnants and collect essential gear enhancement materials. This is the only place to gather what you need for star-rank upgrades if you can survive the climb.

Gravemark Hellsteel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/4de71204cc1e1b3b5757741fe6b92bb0770f4166.png
Only those worthy of legend may wear its legacy.

This legendary armor forged by rare ancient armor pieces, and they can be completed to those who can be able to conquer to mightiest world bosses. According to legend, these armors are infused with the souls of warriors who defied time itself their power sealed within every hammered plate. Those armors are not just armors but also living legend which carries legacy of centuries.

Eidolon of Frostveil

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570153/60fd6a94e6dbbc0a2bf6af387c3aa3ed782fb17c.png
Gravemourn Keep, Drakkmorn Hollow ve Abyssora Sanctum conceal ancient pieces. To claim them, you must face with the Twisted Remnants of Fallen Kings, Molten Guardians of the Hollow and the Abyssal Beasts that lurk beneath the sea.

Boss & Combat Adjustments

 Kraken boss now has a new melee attack pattern.
 Kraken’s overall damage increased by 50%.
 Warhammer – Battle Roar skill now correctly scales with bonus points.
 PVE and PVP character bonuses no longer apply in reverse.
 Arena EXP gains increased by 100%.
 Dungeon Boss and World Boss EXP gains increased by 300%.
 Champion monsters now grant 150% more EXP.

Quests & Progression

 Fixed an issue where creature kill quests on task boards were not counting correctly for appropriate-level enemies.
 World Boss drop rates increased by 30%–70%.
 Treasure Hunt rewards now have a much higher chance of yielding valuable items.
 Set Bonus items can now drop from Treasure Hunts.
 10-Day 100% EXP Event is now active.

Farming & Lifeskills

 Lifeskill EXP gain rates increased.
 EXP distribution adjusted based on skill level for better progression.
 Rented farms limit per character has been removed adventurers can now own unlimited rented farms.

World & Spawns

 Improved spawn consistency for treasure chests and increased tameable creatures in open-world areas.
 Fixed an issue where their numbers would decrease over time.

UI & Technical Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Port Officer NPC window would not open for some players.
 Fixed rare case causing certain characters to be unplayable unless directly interacted with during loading.
 Major backend network fixes applied to address incorrect visual data displays (e.g., false silver amounts, items showing red ‘X’ icons).
 World Boss reward window can no longer be closed using the ESC key.

Localization

 Language updates applied for German, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, and Russian.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Update Notes (02.04.2025)
notes.content:
The Quinfall completed its scheduled maintenance on April 2. You can find the regular maintenance update notes and improvement reviews below.

Gameplay and Quest Adjustments


 Increased the chance of obtaining valuable equipment from Production Workbenches (+60%), Dungeon Bosses (+60%), World Bosses (+60%), Dungeon Treasure Rooms (+90%), and Normal Treasure Rooms (+130%).
 Fixed naming errors in the chain skills of the Meteor Strike skill on Staff weapons.
 Prevented the arena flag from being moved to unreachable locations. The flag now returns to the center when entering a safe zone.
 Gathering profession EXP gain from allied ships is now disabled. Additionally, profession EXP from the same enemy ship can now only be gained once every 20 minutes.
 Tasks on the mission board that required killing lower-level monsters have been adjusted to match the player's level.
 EXP rewards from mission boards have been reduced by 20%.
 Kraken Boss’s damage and debuff radius have been increased.
 Characters with immunity are no longer affected by monster knockback animations.

User Experience, UI, and Access Improvements


 Community-translated languages (Brazilian Portuguese, German, Russian) were added under "Community Support" in the language options.
 An automatic AI-supported in-game chat translation system has been added. This system is enabled by default and can be customized or disabled from chat settings.
 Fixed an issue where NPCs appeared underwater in port areas.
 NPC walking animations have been smoothed.
 Fixed incorrect camera positioning when interacting with ground NPCs.
 Fixed rental house and farm durations appearing as “?”. They will now properly disappear from lists.
 When rental house or farm durations expire, all stored items will be transferred to the player's individual storage. Additional info boxes have been added when inside rental areas.
 Fixed a bug where characters could glitch when exiting certain areas of rental houses without permission.
 Fixed an issue where caravan mounts could not be resummoned if left in another channel.
 Fixed an issue where some players could not access specific channels under certain conditions.
 Fixed an issue where players would occasionally respawn in swamps or snowy areas after dying in port locations. Also fixed ships being auto-teleported to restricted port locations.
 Fixed an issue where ships transferred between ports would return to their old port after a server restart.
 Added a confirmation checkbox for V Store purchases. Mount costumes now include compatibility information. V Coin refunds will no longer be provided for incorrect purchases.
 Added a transaction history list showing up to one week of clan storage activity.
 Previously hidden character stats are now visible in the character stats window.

General System and Performance Improvements


 Fixed an issue where workbenches in rented houses and ships sometimes displayed incorrect data.
 Additional client-side security measures were implemented.
 AntiCheat system has been updated.
 All commands accessible through the in-game Debug console have been removed.
 General optimization work has been done on in-game vegetation. Major optimization efforts like Virtual Geometry and Virtual Texture are ongoing.
 Various server-side performance improvements were applied.

Combat, Skill, and Equipment Balancing


 Prevented cannons on ships from colliding with buildable objects placed around the ship.
 Fixed an issue where certain players lost items in their individual storage under specific conditions.
 Mana consumption of all weapon skills has been increased by 20%-50%.
 Damage points of Crossbow, Bow, Dual Axe, Hammer, and Dagger weapons have been increased by 10%-40%. Work on other weapons and specific skill balancing is ongoing.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Update Notes (20.03.2025)
notes.content:
Quinfall will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on March 20, 2025, between 04:00 and 05:30 (GMT+3, Turkey time). This update contains various fixes and gives a preview of what's coming next.

Connection and Server Improvements


 Significant improvements have been made to connection issues.
 A scalable new server infrastructure has been completed.
 Server capacities have been significantly increased.
 Locked channels can now be activated and new channels can be added as needed.
 Each channel increases capacity while allowing players to play on the same server.
 Fixed an issue where characters would not be in their previous location when reconnecting after disconnecting from Arena battles or dungeons.


Gameplay and Mechanics Updates


 Dungeon daily point increase raised to 300.
 Automatic chat language detection reactivated.
 Shared gatherable resources between channels are now channel-specific. Previously, a tree cut down in one channel was also cut down in another.
 Ships are now limited to a maximum of 5 pieces for chanels while in the water. Previously it was limited to 5 total. Also, ships will no longer appear in your list in different channels while on the water, but may appear in other channels when they are towed to port.
 Fixed an issue where Level 50 characters could not earn Pet EXP.
 Fixed a rare inventory visual bug related to tool activation.
 Population indicator on the channel screen has been temporarily disabled and will be reactivated in the next update according to the new server architecture.
 Character Level, PVP, and PVE rankings have been activated.
 Dungeon Boss drop rates increased by 30%.
 Sorting is now disabled while mass item deletion is enabled.
 Fixed an issue where Clan Shrine badges were required after Level 4 of the Individual Shrine. Individual Shrine badges must now be used.
 Fixed an issue where hunting and gathering EXP did not vary based on material quality.


Language and Community Support


 In-game language options are now open-source.
 Players can now edit these language files to contribute.
 New language options will be added in the future under “Community Support”


Bug Fixes and Optimizations


 Fixed an issue where players could not be recruited into a clan in certain cases.
 Repair kit drop rates have been reduced.
 Fixed an issue where caravan mounts could not be summoned in certain situations.
 The in-game feedback system has been temporarily disabled for an enhanced version (video, screenshot uploads, and other features).
 Fixed an issue where some desert region creatures were positioned in a way that prevented them from dealing damage to players.
 Adjustments were made to ensure that items inside built structures and decorative objects are not lost when removed by players.
 Fixed an issue where shrine circles were sometimes not clearly visible on the world map.
 Teleportation fees are now determined based on level, in addition to distance and weight. Low-level players will have lower teleportation costs.
 Fixed an issue where ship captains could still control the ship after dying.


PVP Updates


 Players who log out during PVP will now lose PVP points, and the last player to deal damage will gain PVP points.
 Players who log out during PVP will respawn at the nearest settlement.
 Upon first login and after teleporting, players now receive a 30-second damage protection shield, which is removed if they move.


Coming Soon - Future Updates


 Weapons Balancing adjustments will be made to improve gameplay experience.
 Clan Quest System will be introduced, allowing clans to participate in unique quests and earn rewards.
 Clan Passive Skill System, providing passive benefits to clan members.
 Development will be made for the current Arena Event.
 NEW Aetherion Clash, offering competitive PVP challenges and exclusive rewards.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Update Notes (05.03.2025)
notes.content:
Server and Performance Improvements


 Server performance improvements were made for large-scale multiplayer environments. Infrastructure enhancements were specifically applied to the European server.
 Improvements were made to address the "Server not responding 01" error caused by weak connections or sudden connection fluctuations.
 Fixes were applied to resolve the AppSign error and the issue where the "AntiCheat Loading" screen would not close upon game entry.
 An AI-supported control system has been added to the in-game chat and PM system to filter out messages containing coin sales, advertisements, or offensive language. Since all messages in General Chat and PM are now filtered through the AI system, they will be delivered with an average delay of 1-2 seconds.


Combat and Skill Balancing


 The EXP rates in Party monster zones have been significantly increased. Additionally, their movement speed has been increased by 25%. The strength and drop rates of Party monsters on islands have also been adjusted accordingly.
 Magic AP attacks can now deal damage to structures.
 Fixed an issue where Staff/LifeStaff skills sometimes failed to deal damage due to server-side protections.
 The issue where using the Invisible Strike dagger skill caused bosses to drop their aggro on the character has been resolved.
 Skill stones now deplete based on the number of skill uses rather than the amount of damage dealt.


Gameplay and User Experience Improvements


 The mount summon cooldown is now reset when using a skill.
 Improvements were made to the Q shortcut command, which allows automatic running, mount control, and ship steering, ensuring it does not interfere with certain combat situations. The command will no longer be canceled during UI interactions or chat usage.
 The daily quest requiring horse feeding can now also be completed by feeding pets.
 Fixed an issue where secondary characters could not properly mount or appeared underneath their mounts.
 Friend List and Block List capacities have been increased to 200/200.
 Fixed a bug where sending a friend request to a non-friend player resulted in a message stating the player was already on the list. Also, fixed an issue where the Friend List sometimes failed to display.
 Fixed an issue preventing clan officers (below the clan leader) from kicking regular members from the clan.
 Several improvements have been made to the clan banner approval process.


Bug Fixes and Technical Updates


 Fixed an issue where ships would disappear or fail to take damage after repairs.
 Certain plant seeds were previously biome-restricted, making some crafting recipes unachievable. These seeds can now be obtained alongside other seeds.
 Fixed a bug where some players could not see their daily login rewards.
 Fixed several visual bugs affecting mounts.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Transparency Announcement (01.03.2025)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

First and foremost, we acknowledge that the past few weeks have been challenging for all of us. We are aware that the technical issues, cheating problems, and delayed updates have shaken your trust in us. With this in mind, we want to be completely transparent with you and share the challenges we’ve faced, the actions we’ve taken, and our plans moving forward.

When we first implemented our anti-cheat system, we believed we could quickly and effectively address known issues. We engaged with reputable companies to find the best solution, but we soon realized that developing a strong and permanent anti-cheat system would take longer than expected. As a result, after extensive discussions and planning, we have reached an agreement with XIGNCODE3. With this new anti-cheat system, cheat detection will be much faster and more efficient. Thanks to your reports, we are committed to making Quinfall a fair and cheat-free gaming environment.

At the same time, we acknowledge that our response to in-game bugs and technical issues has been slower than anticipated due to our team’s limited resources. We understand that our inability to release updates at the pace we initially intended has disappointed many of you. However, despite all these challenges, we have been working hard to resolve these issues and improve the overall game experience. Since the beginning of the Early Access period, we have made significant progress in stabilizing our servers, and while things are in better shape now, we will continue to work on further improvements.

Players who have been caught using cheats have been punished, and our detection efforts are ongoing. With our new anti-cheat system in place, we are taking stronger security measures and will continue to improve in a professional and structured manner.

We also recognize the disappointment caused by the dupe/coin issues over the past few weeks. Based on your feedback, we have decided to apply a rollback system when critical violations occur, even in the full release of the game. This will help minimize potential losses and maintain the integrity of the game’s economy.

Additionally, we want to clarify our stance on wipes. At this time, our current plan is to avoid a full wipe at the end of Early Access, unless a severe technical issue arises. Instead, we are exploring alternative solutions, such as launching "Progression Servers" to help new players integrate with existing ones more smoothly. We value the time, effort, and progress you have made in the game, and we are actively looking for ways to ensure a balanced and enjoyable experience for both new and veteran players.

We also recognize that this has been a frustrating period for many of you, and we truly appreciate your patience. As a token of gratitude for supporting us during Early Access, we will be offering exclusive cosmetic weapon skins, server-wide EXP events, and special discounts on Steam. We hope these initiatives will help make up for the recent difficulties and provide you with a more enjoyable experience moving forward.

At the end of the day, we firmly believe that "From Bugs to Bounty" is a journey we can overcome together. We are deeply grateful for your trust, patience, and support. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and it continues to shape the future of the game.

Performance Improvements


 Server-side optimizations have been implemented.
 Fixed temporary Ping spikes caused by internal technical issues.
 Asia server ping fluctuations due to the data center’s location are being evaluated for further improvements.
 More stable network packet transfers—fixed minor bugs caused by unstable server-side packet transmission.


Security & Anti-Cheat Measures


 XIGNCODE3 Anti-Cheat System with Server-Client verification has been implemented.
 Server-side security enhancements have been added for various in-game processes.
 Additional server-side anti-cheat measures have been introduced to counter specific exploits.


Bug Fixes & Adjustments


 Fixed an issue where Clan PVP/PVE scores displayed as 0 in certain UI sections.
 Defense weapons placed on ships no longer attack non-clan players on Channel 1.
 Auto chat filter for banned words has been added—moderation team will update the blacklist dynamically.
 Resolved issues causing players to get stuck on the login screen. Players still experiencing this should report their character names.
 Arena entry issues, synchronization problems, and other related bugs have been fixed.
 Clan leaders can now kick authorized members without revoking their ranks.


Gameplay Improvements


 Ranking System has been activated. Level/PVE score/PVP score rankings will be available soon after penalty adjustments.
 One-way auto-run/ship sailing added—can be activated by pressing the Q key. A full-map path-finding system will be introduced later.
 Defense and Attack vehicles now require fewer ammunition materials.
 Green horses can now be included in breeding.


Quality of Life Changes


 Mail auto-delete duration extended from 10 days to 30 days.
 Buff icon sizes for NPCs and creatures have been reduced for better UI clarity.


Compensation Rewards


 1,500 V Coins have been uploaded to all accounts.
 10-Day 50% Character/Art/Weapon/Pet/Bot/Arsenal EXP event has been activated on all servers.
 Special costume weapons have been added to individual external storages.
 Private Label activated for all players who have been with us until today.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Patch Notes (17.02.2025)
notes.content:
Quinfall will be under maintenance on 17.02.2025 at 12:00 (CET) for approximately 1 hour. During this time, the servers will be temporarily unavailable as we implement updates and improvements.

General Changes


 The portal providing access to the forbidden swamp area has been removed.
 Material decay requirements in altars and ships have been halved.
 Ship decay system now only applies to interior objects. Ship hull decay has been removed.
 Ships can now be repaired and recalled at the harbor after being destroyed. If a caravan package is on board at the time of destruction, it will drop into the water. No other ship contents will be lost. Ship production requirements have been increased.

Party System Updates


 Party Weapon EXP/Pet EXP will now be evenly distributed among party members instead of being granted to the player landing the final hit.
 Party Drop system now randomly selects a party member to receive the loot instead of the player delivering the final blow.
 Party EXP/Random Drop gains are now limited to a 150-meter radius.

Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where cloth pieces on armor and costumes were invisible in close-up camera angles.
 Fixed an issue where required materials for clan altar upgrades would not appear in certain situations.
 Daily rewards will no longer reset when a day is missed.
 Fixed an issue where the other buy order list would not appear in the central market.
 Fixed an issue where global wind direction and intensity would not function in certain cases.


Anti-Cheat Measures


 Additional server-side measures have been implemented to detect and prevent identified cheats.
 Continued development on client-side anti-cheat solutions is ongoing.

New Storage System


 An External Storage system has been added to storage NPCs for special event rewards and specific system items. Items placed in External Storage by the system can be transferred to the inventory or regular storage, but players cannot manually place items into External Storage.

Server Mergers


 Europe 2 / America 2 / Asia 2 servers have been merged into their respective regional servers.


Exceptions:


 Character Name Conflicts: Both characters with the same name have been granted a name change option.
 Altar Conflicts: All materials used and all structures/items within conflicting altar areas have been transferred to the External Storage system. This applies to both individual and clan altars.
 Storage Merges: If two storage units from the same player were merged and exceeded capacity, excess items were transferred to the Individual External Storage.
 Character Slot Adjustments: When merging characters from different accounts of the same player, additional character slots were provided to accommodate the total number of merged characters.


Account Data Merge


 Account-level data such as V Coin, Tokens, Achievements, and Tags have been merged into existing accounts where applicable.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Patch Notes (09.02.2025)
notes.content:
Anti-Cheat & Security


 Added an automatic installer to resolve Anti-Cheat installation errors.
 Fixed an issue preventing character template files and clan banners from loading due to Anti-Cheat restrictions.
 Easy Anti-Cheat has been activated.


Chat System


 Global chat is now available after reaching level 25.
 Message sending cooldown increased to 10 seconds.


UI & Localization


 Various interface and text translation improvements.


Clan System


 Fixed an issue where players could withdraw items from the clan storage despite lacking placement permissions.


Dungeons & Bosses


 Reduced the frequency of Dungeon Boss skills.
 Decreased the HP of all Dungeon Bosses by 20%.
 Significant adjustments to Dungeon Boss loot drops. Now guarantees at least three rewards per drop.


Weapons & Skills


 Reduced the range of certain Staff and Life Staff skills by 30%.


Item System


 Fixed an issue where power cards ignored filters for some players.
 Added a bulk item deletion feature in the inventory.

notes.title: The Quinfall - Update Notes 06/02
notes.content:
Greetings Quinfallers,

We completely understand that some of you may be frustrated by the wait, but we want to emphasize that we are working hard to implement an anti-cheat system that will be fully effective once it’s live. While the process has taken a bit longer than anticipated due to licensing and discussions with various firms, we’ve now set the latest completion date for February 10th. However, we may be able to roll out the anti-cheat system sooner after performing some final checks and tests.

In the meantime, we’ve gathered feedback from many of you regarding certain adjustments. Specifically, some issues were identified around the drop rates of materials from monsters and the production process on the Lifeskill side. To address this, we’ve made several adjustments to the item drops from monsters.

Regarding the server-side capacity, we’ve made significant progress, but we’re not quite there yet. While some servers are more stable, we are still working to resolve occasional issues on others. Rest assured, we’ll continue fixing and improving this as we move forward.

Here are the latest updates in their respective categories:

Gameplay Adjustments:


 Build System: Fixed an issue where players were unable to place or remove parts in certain situations.
 Two-Handed Sword: Fixed an issue where the Ground Smash ability also knocked down friendly players.
 Crossbow: Fixed the Pushback Bolt ability to no longer deal more damage than intended.
 Life Staff: Fixed the issue where Healing Ground and Team Health abilities were not affected by the healing skill stone.
 Bow: Fixed the Explosive Trap ability to no longer give speed boosts to other players.
 Bow: Fixed the Trap Retreat ability, which was not reducing cooldown despite skill point increases.
 Dual Blades: Fixed an issue where the Lethal Ambush and Deathly Cascade abilities reset the skill on monster death.
 Handmade & Ready-Made Potions: Balanced potion durations and effects. 


Crafting & Production:


 Crafting Requirements: Fixed an issue where livestock and farming materials in the Sanctuary area had increased decay requirements.
 Tool Knife: Fixed the crafting materials for the Tool Knife.
 Special Powers on Tools: Removed the visual effects for special powers on tools, as they were not affecting the characters.


Loot & Item Drops:


 Monster Drops: Many equipment and materials gained from professions have been removed from monster drops.
 Essence Drops: Reduced the frequency of essence drops from monsters.
 Pet & Mount Food Requirements: Adjusted the food needs for pets and mounts.
 Pet Auto-Collect: Fixed an issue where the filter was not working for Power Cards during pet auto-collect.
 Pet Drops: Fixed the issue where fallen pets were only dropping Woodcutting and Gathering-related items. Now other profession-related pets can drop as well.


Bosses & Dungeons:


 Dungeon Bosses: Slightly reduced the power and attack speed of dungeon bosses.
 Dungeon Boss Loot: Improved loot drops from dungeon bosses.


Other Fixes:


 Clan Invitations: Fixed an issue where clan invitations were not working correctly.


Thank you for your continued patience! We are excited to bring these improvements to you soon. Please stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Community Information - Transparency Update
notes.content:
Dear Quinfall Community,

First and foremost, we acknowledge the server issues and attacks that have impacted your gaming experience. Since launch, ongoing attacks and technical limitations have forced us to restrict the number of servers and reduce their capacity. While this decision was made to ensure that as many players as possible could access the game with minimal disruption, we understand that many of you have experienced long queue times and server instability.

To address these issues, we have been actively working on adding new servers and optimizing server capacity. Once these improvements are complete, we will transition to higher-capacity servers and merge certain servers where necessary. This will create a more stable and balanced environment for everyone. However, given the technical complexity of this process, we need to implement these changes gradually and carefully.

At this time, we want to be transparent that server-related issues have not yet been fully resolved, and periodic server restarts may still be required. We understand that these disruptions can be frustrating, and we are doing everything possible to minimize them.

We truly appreciate your patience and support. Once we have overcome these challenges, we will express our gratitude by providing compensation rewards and hosting special events. Our ultimate goal is to ensure that, once these issues are resolved, everyone can enjoy a smoother and more enjoyable Quinfall experience.

We are committed to maintaining open communication and keeping you informed throughout this process. Thank you all for your understanding and continued support.

Sincerely,
Vawraek Technology Team

notes.title: Community Announcement: Information and Updates
notes.content:
First and foremost, we’d like to address the server queue issues that many of you have been eagerly waiting for updates on and, at times, found frustrating. Our team has been working tirelessly to resolve this matter, and after carefully considering your feedback, we are excited to announce that later today, we will activate three new servers for the Europe, America, and Asia regions. This is a major step toward alleviating access issues and ensuring a more enjoyable experience for all our players.

In addition, we believe it’s time to provide a more comprehensive explanation regarding other issues and challenges we’ve faced since the launch. Despite working alongside a reputable cybersecurity firm, we have encountered large-scale DDoS attacks since the game’s release. These attacks have significantly impacted our systems and server performance, disrupting the experience for our players. Our primary focus has been to analyze these issues thoroughly and determine the extent to which we can stabilize and safeguard our systems. This has required extensive collaboration with our security team, which is why we refrained from making a detailed statement until now.

We are committed to a long-term improvement process.

We recognize that there is a long road ahead in addressing current issues and implementing improvements based on your feedback. While it is a source of pride for us to have such a large player base, we also acknowledge that, as a smaller game studio, there have been moments when we struggled to meet the high demand on time. For these shortcomings, we sincerely apologize to our entire community.

Our Future Steps:


 Resolving server issues: The addition of three new servers will help reduce access issues. Furthermore, we are planning capacity upgrades for all servers.
 Enhancing cybersecurity: Our security team, in collaboration with a cybersecurity firm, continues to implement stronger measures to counteract DDoS attacks.
 Improving communication: We are committed to maintaining more frequent and transparent communication with you. We will keep you informed of any updates, issues, or progress related to resolving ongoing challenges.
 Compensation gifts: Once all issues have been resolved, we will express our gratitude for your patience and support by distributing compensation gifts to our players.


We are confident that we will overcome this challenging period together. Your support and understanding continue to inspire us as we work to elevate Quinfall to the level it deserves. Thank you for your patience and for contributing to this journey with your constructive feedback.

We remain dedicated to providing you with a better gaming experience as soon as possible.

Sincerely,
Vawraek Technology Team

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions: Quinfall 2nd Closed Beta
notes.content:
How do I access the Closed Beta key?

You need to register again on the Quinfall website with the email address you received the closed beta invitation. Please make sure to update and maintain your system information and profile! The beta key will appear in your profile.

How do I know if I have been selected for the Closed Beta?

The selection process for the Quinfall Closed Beta was completed in previous months, and the selected users were notified via email. On June 20, 2024, keys will be distributed to the invited users, allowing them to access the game on Steam PlayTest.

How will the Quinfall Beta Schedule proceed?

Below is our schedule for the Beta. During this period, users can share their experiences and report any issues they encounter through the bug-reports channel on Discord. Users who submit the most bug reports will be rewarded with special names and prominent roles on the Quinfall Discord.

Beta Schedule:


 Beta Key Distribution: June 20, 2024
 Closed Beta Start Date: June 22, 2024
 Closed Beta End Date: June 27, 2024, 12:00 (GMT+3)

 
I wasn't invited to the Closed Beta. How can I stay updated?

The Quinfall 2nd Closed Beta is not under any NDA. Players and content creators are free to share their experiences with you. Likewise, we will host live Q&A sessions about the Quinfall Beta to keep you informed.

What are Quinfall system requirements?
 
Minimum:

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4160 / AMD CPU with 4 physical cores @ 3Ghz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 270X
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 55 GB available space

Recommended:

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon R9 390X
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 55 GB available space
